comment: Whether the "order ready for pickup" notification email is sent to customers.
modal: Controls whether customers receive the **Order Ready For Pickup** email when their in-store pickup order is ready to collect. Can be set per website or store view.
basis: group:Order Ready For Pickup in Store

comment: Which store email identity the "order ready for pickup" email is sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity for the Order Ready For Pickup email — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Can differ per store view.
basis: group:Order Ready For Pickup in Store

comment: Whether copies of the "order ready for pickup" email are sent as Bcc or as a separate email.
modal: Chooses how copy recipients receive the Order Ready For Pickup email: **Bcc** (hidden on the customer's copy) or as a **Separate Email**. Can differ per store view.
basis: group:Order Ready For Pickup in Store
